items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But me and Erroll Garner heard him during his last days and he wasn’t doing too well, but I admired him when he was right.

ctx.x: In what way? How did his greatness differ from some of these other players?
I don’t know. But me and Erroll Garner heard him during his last days and he wasn’t doing too well, but I admired him when he was right. When he and Buttercup were together, you know.
